name: Twistspine Pricklypear
desc: Twistspine Pricklypear (Opuntia macrorhiza): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Opuntia macrorhiza, also known as the prairie pricklypear, western pricklypear, twistpine pricklypear, or plains pricklypear, is a common, widespread species of cactus native to North America.
